description.value: Carleton Lodge is a condominium-style boutique hotel offering eight fully-equipped private suites on five stories at the base of Whistler and Blackcomb mountains, directly beside both high-speed gondolas. Managed by the Sundial Hotel, it provides 24/7 on-site guest services, maintenance, and security. Whistler is home to Crankworx and world-class mountain biking, making this a strategically located base for cyclists visiting the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active condominium-style accommodation at 4280 Mountain Square, Whistler, with active booking pages and 2025/2026 cancellation policies. Gear storage is evidenced by: 'Each suite has its own gear storage locker to store your gear, making coming and going from the mountain even easier.' Wi-Fi is corroborated by OSM internet_access=wlan but not explicitly named on the website. The contact page lists a local 604 number distinct from the toll-free 888 number in OSM and the site footer, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM and site footer list toll-free 1-888-499-2233, but the Contact page explicitly lists a distinct local number, 1-604-932-2321, as the property phone. Both appear on the website; the local number may be the more direct line.
Wi-Fi confirmed by OSM tag (internet_access=wlan) but not explicitly mentioned in website content — amenity marked null per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operating hotel in the heart of Whistler Village at the base of the gondolas, with per-suite gear storage lockers and 24/7 staffing — a strong fit for touring and mountain cyclists visiting Whistler.
enrichment_extras.notes: Property is managed by Sundial Hotel, which is noted as the #1 TripAdvisor-ranked hotel in Whistler. The webcam page references Crankworx and bike lift lineups, confirming awareness of cycling guests.
